newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M names Canadian Xmas its underwear model.
newsitem.headline: H&M names Canadian Xmas its underwear model.

text.p: Swedish retail chain Hennes & Mauritz said on Friday that Canadian Natasha Henstridge, an actress and model working in Los Angeles, is to model its Christmas range of underwear.
The female model for H&M's traditionally eye-catching and often controversial ad campaign is always a closely-guarded secret until the last moment.
But the Swedish tabloid Aftonbladet broke the news on Friday, naming Henstridge and publishing pictures of her in a centrefold including a topless pose from one of her films.
The clothes retailer, whose underwear posters have in the past attracted criticism from women's organisations and traffic police, said this year's campaign will begin on December 2 in Sweden.
Norway, Denmark, Britain, Germany, Belgium, Netherlands, Switzerland and Austria will also be targeted.

Henstridge, now 22, was cover-girl on French magazine Cosmopolitan at the age of 14, appeared in the science-fiction film "Species" with Ben Kingsley, and recently finished filming "Maximum Risk" with Jean-Claude van Damme.

Photographer Tiziano Magni shot the H&M pictures in Los Angeles over two days, the retailer said, adding that further information could be obtained on its website www.jbab.se/direkt/hm. Tony Austin, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
